purpose: Machine-readable entry, route parameter and context requirements for known Goofish/Xianyu pages.

entryModeDefinitions.DIRECT_LIVE_READ_ONLY: Known page can be opened under current profile for read-only structural observation.
entryModeDefinitions.LIVE_ENTRY_BOUNDARY_READ: Known entry can be opened only to identify download/app/client boundary; do not continue into external action.
entryModeDefinitions.USER_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: Requires user-provided URL or explicit business context; do not guess parameters.
entryModeDefinitions.STATIC_EVIDENCE_ONLY: Describe from static evidence; do not open merely for coverage.
entryModeDefinitions.INTERNAL_OR_MODULE_ONLY: Treat as module/resource path rather than user-facing page.
entryModeDefinitions.UNKNOWN_TRIAGE: Run unknown page triage before any deeper observation.

contextRequirementDefinitions.PUBLIC_DIRECT: No private context required; read public structure only.
contextRequirementDefinitions.CURRENT_PROFILE_DIRECT_READ: Current logged-in profile is enough; read structure with redaction.
contextRequirementDefinitions.PUBLIC_OR_NEUTRAL_QUERY_ALLOWED: A neutral or user-provided search query may be used; drop the query value from output.
contextRequirementDefinitions.VISIBLE_LINK_OR_ROUTE_SHAPE_ONLY: Use only visible navigation links or keep route shape; do not invent entry ids.
contextRequirementDefinitions.READ_ROUTE_SHAPE_ONLY: Read parameter names and route shape; drop values.
contextRequirementDefinitions.USER_PROVIDED_CONTEXT_ONLY: Wait for user-provided URL or explicit target context.
contextRequirementDefinitions.STATIC_DESCRIPTION_ONLY: Use static bundle and existing route evidence only.
contextRequirementDefinitions.SHELL_IDENTIFICATION_ONLY: Only identify login, iframe, app bridge, download or permission shell.
contextRequirementDefinitions.PROFILE_OR_SITE_ALIAS_ONLY: Use only the current browser profile and a site/profile alias; do not store real account or store identity.

globalRules: Never persist concrete query/hash parameter values.
Do not construct order, user, chat, address, invoice, payment or redirect parameters.
For seller pages, record only a site/profile alias, not the real account or store identity.
Static and module routes are not coverage targets for live probing.
Shell/container routes stop at boundary identification unless the embedded target is separately reviewed.
